title: Junior Web Developer Firegang Dental Marketing
description: A dynamic opportunity to join the Junior Web Developer team at Firegang Dental Marketing, where you'll work remotely on a full-time basis. This role focuses on web development, with responsibilities including content updates, website maintenance, and client support. You'll collaborate with designers and contribute to creating visually appealing and functional websites.

requirements.description: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.
Basic knowledge of front-end technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery).
Proficiency with WordPress CMS, including content management and plugin installation. Experience with debugging tools like Chrome DevTools.

bonus_points: Familiarity with PHP and basic MySQL databases knowledge.

soft_skills.description: Problem-solving skills for identifying and resolving daily website issues.
Strong communication skills for collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

pros: Proactive learning of new technologies. Ability to adapt to updates in tech environment.
cons: No specific exposure to UI/UX design concepts. Familiarity with SEO best practices is mentioned but not explicitly listed.
